mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate at or below 0.5% signals accommodative monetary policy, which reduces discount rates for equity valuation and produces positive 5-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward return distribution in periods with FEDFUNDS <= 0.5% shows no significant positive skew (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the unemployment rate exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions, triggering negative 5-day S&P 500 returns due to reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings expectations.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns in instances where UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in 3 months are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous expansion in GDP (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) above their 12-month moving averages signals robust aggregate demand, producing positive 20-day S&P 500 returns through elevated corporate earnings expectations.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 and HOUST both > 12-month moving average
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns in periods where both GDPC1 and HOUST exceed their 12-month moving averages are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production falling below 100 (index 2017=100) indicates manufacturing contraction, leading to negative 60-day S&P 500 returns due to reduced corporate output and profit margins.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns in periods with INDPRO < 100 are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) above 1500 thousand units signals strong residential demand, correlating with positive 20-day S&P 500 returns through elevated consumer spending and corporate revenue growth.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns in periods with HOUST > 1500 are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL exceeding 260 (index 1982-1984=100) signals accelerating inflation, triggering negative 5-day S&P 500 returns due to anticipated monetary tightening and increased discount rates.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns in periods with CPIAUCSL > 260 are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous payroll growth (PAYEMS) and unemployment decline (UNRATE) above their 12-month moving averages signals labor market strength, driving positive 20-day S&P 500 returns through increased consumer spending.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns in periods where PAYEMS > 12-month MA and UNRATE < 12-month MA are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Real sales and services (RSAFS) exceeding 500,000 million dollars signals robust consumer spending, leading to positive 60-day S&P 500 returns through sustained economic growth and corporate profitability.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns in periods with RSAFS > 500000 are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
